//: Sample MCP client configuration for the FileShare MCP server.
//notes: The server is documentation-only today; command/args are placeholders for a future implementation.
Never commit real secrets. FILESHARE_API_URL is the only required env var for the MCP server itself.
FILESHARE_PAGE_TOKEN is optional and must be a slug-scoped HS256 JWT (24h) from POST /api/pages/[slug]/verify.

fileshare-local.comment: Point at a local dev instance (npm run dev on :3000).
